label: Heavy going
summary: Markets dominated. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq more than 5% as AI stocks cracked after Anthropic's debut, with the VIX near 36 and gold also sliding. In the Gulf war, the Saudi-led coalition intercepted three Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh, and Poland and its allies called Russian missiles a provocation even as Trump reported 'very good talks' with Putin on Ukraine. COP31 ran into overtime, deadlocked over a draft that no longer mentions fossil fuels. A magnitude 6.7 earthquake shook central Peru with no injuries reported, and Haiti's army fought gangs in the capital. On the brighter side, French courts sentenced three police officers over a racist assault, and Africa's new credit rating agency drew attention. The weighted formula gave 39; no editorial adjustment.
